command: bun .beegame/tmp/gen-drafts.mjs && bun .beegame/delivery/check-content.mjs --layout-draft .beegame/tmp/drafts/ui-start.json 960 540 --game-view game-view --camera .beegame/tmp/camera-draft.json 2>&1 | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1)[:3000])"

sed -i '' 's/    id: "start-plane",/    parentId: "game-view",\
    id: "start-plane",/; s/    id: "hud-plane",/    parentId: "game-view",\
    id: "hud-plane",/' .beegame/tmp/gen-drafts.mjs && bun .beegame/tmp/gen-drafts.mjs && bun .beegame/delivery/check-content.mjs --layout-draft .beegame/tmp/drafts/ui-start.json 960 540 --game-view game-view --camera .beegame/tmp/camera-draft.json 2>&1 | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1)[:4000])"

cat > $TMPDIR/summarize.py <<'EOF'
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
if not d.get("ok",d.get("valid")):
    print("FAIL:", json.dumps(d.get("issues"),ensure_ascii=False)[:500]); sys.exit()
diag=d.get("diagnostics",{})
for k in ["outsideViewport","outsideParent","outsideContentArea","overlapCandidates","outsideCameraView"]:
    v=diag.get(k,[])
    if v: print(f"  {k}:", json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False)[:300])
bc=d.get("boundaryChecks",[])
for b in bc:
    flags={k:b.get(k) for k in ["outsideViewport","outsideParent","outsideContentArea","outsideCameraView"] if b.get(k)}
    if flags: print("  boundary", b.get("viewport"), flags)
print("  ok; clean" if all(not diag.get(k) for k in ["outsideViewport","outsideParent","outsideContentArea","overlapCandidates","outsideCameraView"]) else "")
EOF
for f in start:game-view:camera gameplay:game-view:camera pause: :  result: : error: : loading: :; do
  name=${f%%:*}; rest=${f#*:}
  echo "== $name =="
  for size in 960x540 390x844 320x480 600x700 540x540; do
    w=${size%x*}; h=${size#*x}
    if [ "$name" = start ] || [ "$name" = gameplay ]; then
      cmd="--layout-draft .beegame/tmp/drafts/ui-$name.json $w $h --game-view game-view --camera .beegame/tmp/camera-draft.json"
    else
      cmd="--layout-draft .beegame/tmp/drafts/ui-$name.json $w $h"
    fi
    echo -n "[$size]"
    bun .beegame/delivery/check-content.mjs $cmd 2>&1 | python3 $TMPDIR/summarize.py
  done
done
